I have a technically 11 button mouse (Logitech Proteus) that for me is more like a 7 button because I have tiny hands. There are several buttons I can reach with my thumb - I mapped three of them to shift, alt, and ctrl. That way I can still use my mouse for movement, and don't have to move my left hand off my number keys. But also don't have a full on mmo mouse with the grid of keys, I find those a pain in the ass to use. A 7 button is cheaper, too. 

For my red mage, I have cooldowns mapped to ctrl+numbers, my melee combo to alt, unaspected spells to shift, and black/white spells to my main bar. I'd show you if the game wasn't down.

Mostly I just sort my skills into what's easiest for me to hit -- Ver spells are on the main bar, a little harder to hit but still easy are my openers/fillers, far enough away that I have to be deliberate about it is my melee combo, and hardest to hit but still easily accessible are cooldowns. Note that I really only utilize 1-5 on each bar -- the stuff that I rarely use ends up in 6-0. Those I often mouse click, since I have tiny child hands and one stays on my mouse at all times.

It does slow me down, I used to be exclusively a mouse clicker/keyboard movement in MMOs, but made the switch to mouse movement and keyboard for abilities about 2 years ago, and it really improved my response time. Clicking the distant keys is just faster than moving my left hand down the number row and making sure I'm in the right spot, which is why only occasional use abilities go down there.

Not sure about your class questions, but the game is quite newbie friendly, and I haven't seen any real stratification of free companies (guilds in this game).

When it comes to leveling, just do the main scenario quests and any blue quest markets with a plus. Everything is gates behind the MSQ, and Blue quests all unlock things like features and dungeons. The MSQ will be more than enough to get your first class leveled up. And when you're level 15, go to an inn in a major city and do the hall of the novice, you'll get some decent gear and a ring that gives 30% bonus exp to level 30.
